dct_title_s: Equatorial Guinea - Subnational Edge-matched Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: Equatorial Guinea administrative level 0-2 edge-matched gazetteer, shapefiles, geodatabase, and EMF files. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative [COD-AB available here](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-gnq); however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats.
